        height: auto;
        max-width: 45%;
        margin: 10px;
    }

    .image:hover {
        box-shadow: 4px 4px 10px #4fd84f;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    .image-popup {
        height: auto;
        max-width: 50%;
    }


    /* Style for the text */
    .text {
        text-align: center;
        color: white;
        margin-top: 20px;
        font-size: 165px;
        line-height: 1.2;
        font: small-caps bold 65px sans-serif;
        /* Adjust line height as needed */

    .popup {
        width: 80%;
        padding: 15px;
        left: 0;
        margin-left: 5%;
        border: 1px solid rgb(1, 82, 73);
        border-radius: 10px;
        color: rgb(1, 82, 73);
        background: white;
        position: absolute;
        top: 20%;
        box-shadow: 5px 5px 5px #000;
        z-index: 10001;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 26px;
    }

    .overlay {
        position: fixed;
        width: 100%;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .85);
        z-index: 10000;
        display: none;
    }

    @media (min-width: 768px) {
        .popup {
            width: 66.66666666%;

    @media (min-width: 992px) {
        .popup {
            width: 80%;
            margin-left: 25%;

    @media (min-width: 1200px) {
        .popup {
            width: 33.33333%;
            margin-left: 33.33333%;
        }

    .dialog-btn-confirm {

    .dialog-btn-cancel {
        background-color: #ed8a8a;
        color: white;
        font-weight: 700;
        border: 1px solid #ed8a8a;
        border-radius: 10px;
        height: 40px;
        width: 30%;
        font-size: 16px;
    }

    .dialog-btn-cancel:hover {
        background-color: #976060;
        cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

    * Reset */ @import url(//codepen.io/chrisdothtml/pen/ojLzJK.css);

    .tiles {
        width: 1040px;
        font-size: 0;
        text-align: center;
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        left: 50%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

    }

    .tiles .tile {
        display: inline-block;
        margin: 10px;
        text-align: left;
        opacity: 0.99;
        overflow: hidden;
        position: relative;
        border-radius: 3px;
        box-shadow: 0 0 20px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    }

    .tiles .tile:before {
        content: "";
        background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) 100%);
        width: 100%;
        height: 51%;
        opacity: 0;
        position: absolute;
        top: 100%;
        left: 0;
        z-index: 2;
        transition-property: top, opacity;
        transition-duration: 0.3s;
        animation: slideFromBottom 1s forwards;
        /* New animation on start */
    }

    @keyframes slideFromBottom {
        0% {
            top: 100%;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        100% {
            top: 50%;
            opacity: 1;
        }
    }

    .tiles .tile img {
        display: block;
        maxWidth: 200px
        backface-visibility: hidden;
        -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
    }

    .tiles .tile .details {
        font-size: 16px;
        padding: 20px;
        color: #fff;
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 0;
        left: 0;
        z-index: 3;
    }

    .tiles .tile .details span {
        display: block;
        opacity: 0;
        position: relative;
        top: 100px;
        transition-property: top, opacity;
        transition-duration: 0.3s;
        transition-delay: 0s;
        animation: slideFromTop 1s forwards;
        /* New animation on start */
    }

    @keyframes slideFromTop {
        0% {
            top: 100px;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        100% {
            top: 0;
            opacity: 1;
        }
    }


    .tiles .tile .details .title {
        line-height: 1;
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 26px;
    }

    .tiles .tile .details .info {
        line-height: 1.2;
        margin-top: 10px;
        font-size: 20px;
    }

    .tiles .tile:focus:before,
    .tiles .tile:focus span {
        opacity: 1;
        top: 50%;
        /* Adjust as needed */
    }

    .tiles .tile:focus span {
        top: 0;
        /* Adjust as needed */
    }
</style>
